scientific_integrity: The 128 constructive lower-bound classes and the minimum length were proved in earlier work. The result proves equality of that lower bound with the global number of classes by a complete soundly pruned census. The earlier report is dated March 1973 without an exact day; 2012-11-22 is the earliest verified exact-day public primary source date in this record, not a claim that the topic originated in 2012.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for five symbols and length nineteen; no all-alphabet theorem and no independent historical-priority certification.
title: The 128 Newey classes exhaust the shortest five-letter permutation-subsequence words
